stable.release_notes: AgentNEO 3.0.24 adds activity-aware long-task execution, stream/context/token progress monitoring, improved model diagnostics, corrected idle/ready status handling, ComfyUI launch/readiness controls, automatic media model presets, workflow discovery/generation, and pre-submit ComfyUI workflow validation. This updater is validated from AgentNEO 3.0.23.
